The documented setup supplies these values through the project root .env file.

evidences.reason: Defines API calls and structured results as the analysis phase.

save-by-default.text: Automatically save analysis results as timestamped JSON under results/{category}/ by default. Use the operation's category, including reports, realtime, searchconsole, indexing, or metadata as applicable. Honor save=false on functions that expose a save option.

custom-ga4-report.text: Run custom GA4 reports with the caller's selected dimensions and metrics for the applicable date range. Honor supplied dimension filters, sort order, and row limit. Return structured rows with dimension and metric values.

evidences.reason: Documents the query selections, optional controls, and result content.

compare-periods.text: Compare the two supplied date ranges side by side with the same selected dimensions and metrics for both periods. Default to date with activeUsers, sessions, and screenPageViews. Keep each supplied range associated with its own result and preserve the first and second period order.

evidences.reason: Requires a side-by-side comparison of two date ranges.
Specifies shared report selections, defaults, and the pairing of each input range with its corresponding result.

request-indexing.text: For a single re-indexing request, submit the specified full URL to Google with type URL_UPDATED and return the notification's URL, type, and notification time.

evidences.reason: Specifies the full URL input, the re-crawl action, and the notification result.
Publishes the update using the supplied URL and constructs the corresponding notification result.

request-indexing-batch.text: For the low-level batch re-indexing operation, submit the specified URLs sequentially to avoid rate limiting and return the corresponding notification results in input order when the batch succeeds.

evidences.reason: Requires sequential processing and a batch of notification results.
Appends each URL's notification in input order and returns the collected results.

reindex-urls.text: For the high-level re-indexing operation, request re-crawling for the specified URLs and report the outcome for each URL in input order. Continue through a per-URL failure and keep its error associated with that URL.

evidences.reason: Defines high-level re-indexing for multiple URLs.
Records a submission or error for each attempted URL and continues processing the list.

inspect-url.text: Inspect the specified URL in the configured Search Console site and return its index status, including verdict and coverage state, with last crawl time, mobile usability, and rich-results information when available.

evidences.reason: Specifies the URL inspection action and the advertised inspection information.
Sends the supplied inspection URL with the configured site.
Shows which inspection data is core and which depends on Google returning it.

check-index-status.text: For a high-level index-status check, inspect each supplied URL and keep the result associated with that same URL in input order. Mark a successful inspection as indexed when the index-status verdict is PASS, provide the status, and record a per-URL error if the inspection fails while continuing with the remaining URLs.

evidences.reason: Defines checking whether the supplied URLs are indexed.
Defines the verdict interpretation and preserves the association of each URL with its status or error.

evidences.reason: Describes keyword analysis as queries with a device breakdown.
